about_the_game:
Gameplay Description​

​Embark on a Roguelite Card-Battling RPG Adventure!​​

​Conquer Procedural Challenges:​​ Test your wits against a series of dynamically generated levels and unique monsters.

​Master Strategic Deck-Building:​​ Combine hundreds of cards and exploit the deep ​Elemental Rock-Paper-Scissors​ system to crush your enemies.

​Evolve Through Victory:​​ Every defeated foe can drop random cards, empowering you to refine your strategy on the fly. Discover the perfect ​synergy​ that matches your playstyle.

​Forge Your Legacy:​​ Your hero grows stronger with each battle. Carefully choose your ​upgrade path​ from a rich ​RPG progression tree​ to build your power and prepare for the ultimate final challenge!

Game Core Features

  • Rich Deck-Building & Synergy. Collect and combine hundreds of ​uniquely designed cards​ across multiple ​archetypes​ and ​elements.

  • The Decisive "King's Draw"​. A thrilling pre-turn draw that can instantly ​swing the battle​ in your favor or present a brutal challenge!​

  • Deep Elemental Rock-Paper-Scissors. ​Master a nuanced system of ​strong and weak synergies​ between elements. Discover powerful ​interactions​ to crush your enemies!​

  • ​Strategic RPG Progression. Customize your hero by allocating ​stat points​ to create powerful ​builds​ that ​synergize​ perfectly with your deck.​

  • Rogue-lite Progression & The Final Challenge. Victory rewards you with random cards to ​strengthen your deck. Push your luck, ​build an unstoppable combo, and challenge the final boss to claim your crown!​

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 1 MB RAM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 1 MB RAM

short_description: King or Nothing: Your Choices Forge Your Fate.​​ Embark on an epic adventure that blends ​deck-building​ and ​character progression. Master the ​elemental advantage​ and strategically ​synergize your cards​ to crush your enemy. ​Will you claim the throne or fall into oblivion? The challenge awaits.​
